Senior Backend Engineer — Payments Platform
Company: Northwind Financial (fictional, for testing purposes)
Location: Remote (EU timezones)

ABOUT THE ROLE
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Payments Platform team. You'll own
critical services that process financial transactions at scale, working closely with our
infrastructure and risk teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Design and build resilient, event-driven microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
- Own the reliability of high-throughput Kafka-based data pipelines, including exactly-once
  processing guarantees for financial transactions.
- Design and evolve our PostgreSQL data layer, including partitioning and read-scaling
  strategies for tables with hundreds of millions of rows.
- Drive incident response and write postmortems for production issues in the payments path.
- Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes (EKS), with strong observability via
  Prometheus/Grafana.
- Mentor mid-level and junior engineers; participate in architecture reviews.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 7+ years of professional backend engineering experience, with deep Java expertise.
- Production experience with Spring Boot, Kafka (or an equivalent event streaming system),
  and relational databases at scale (PostgreSQL preferred).
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and AWS.
- Demonstrated ownership of a service through an incident from detection to postmortem.
- Strong testing discipline: integration testing against real dependencies, not just mocks.

NICE TO HAVE
- Experience with financial systems, PCI-DSS, or other regulated environments.
- Experience with event sourcing or CQRS.
- AWS certification.
